Headline: Red Line Service Running with Delays
ShortDescription: Red Line trains are running with delays near Fullerton due to heavy train traffic & congestion.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Red Line trains are running with delays near Fullerton due to heavy train traffic & congestion.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore normal service. Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Harlem-bound Green Line Delays
ShortDescription: UPDATE: Harlem-bound Green trains are running with residual delays following earlier police activity at California. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Harlem-bound Green trains are running with residual delays following earlier police activity at California.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
